I recently dined at Vi Sài Gòn, a newly opened gem in HCMC, and it truly exceeded expectations. The ambiance is a harmonious blend of Vietnamese elegance, with open seating areas perfect for group gatherings, alongside private dining options for a more intimate experience. The soothing instrumental music adds a relaxed vibe, making it an ideal spot to unwind.

As someone with celiac, dining out can often be a challenge, but Luna, our server, was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about gluten-free options, which made the experience stress-free. I started with their vegetable soup, which was flavorful and comforting, paired with a refreshing peach tea. My boyfriend ordered the Northwest grilled chicken, served beautifully with rice in bamboo—both the presentation and taste were outstanding.

The hospitality at Vi Sài Gòn was exceptional, and their selection of fresh, health-focused drinks was a highlight. It’s clear they prioritize both quality and guest experience. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, Vi Sài Gòn is a must-try for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Vietnamese flavors in a welcoming atmosphere.
